_doc: Tile catalog — single source of truth for all tile products. Hand-edited. Generators in this directory consume this file and emit markdown into specs/_partials/. See data/README.md.
_pricing_rule: Set baht_per_box + tiles_per_box + m2_per_box for box-priced tiles (most common). Set baht_per_tile and/or baht_per_m2 when sold loose or when only those numbers are listed. The generator picks the most accurate available.

tile-pemo-beige-3060.name: COTTO Pemo Beige 30×60
tile-pemo-beige-3060.notes: Glazed porcelain, water absorption group BIb. HomePro page lists ห้องน้ำ + ห้องครัว + outdoor as suitable applications.

tile-marbella-dgdv6001.name: Marbella Granito Desa-Cream DGDV6001
tile-marbella-dgdv6001.notes: Glossy on a wet floor is a slip hazard — NOT for the bathroom unless paired with a non-slip mat at the shower. Rectified status not stated on the Global House page; at this price tier assume non-rectified, plan 3–5 mm grout.

tile-marbella-hj2127-satin.name: Marbella Freedom-Grey HJ2127 Satin
tile-marbella-hj2127-satin.notes: Same size as DGDV6001 but Satin finish. Global House page lists ห้องน้ำ as a suitable use under the matt/satin variant. Price not visible on the JS-rendered Global House page — capture at the showroom or by phone.

tile-marbella-l4910-matt.name: Marbella L4910 Rustic Matt
tile-marbella-l4910-matt.notes: Big format (450×900) — single tile is ~15 % of a small bathroom floor area, lots of cuts, lots of waste. Suits living / terrace / outdoor, not the bathroom.

tile-homepro-antislip-30.name: HomePro house-brand anti-slip 30×30 light grey
tile-homepro-antislip-30.notes: No fixed SKU — budget anti-slip line at every HomePro branch. Builder verifies R10/R11 on the box label before buying. 30×30 size means more grout lines (visually busier) but more cuts forgiven (good in a small bathroom).
